purpose.objective: Evaluate where Ponytail can improve common-harness work and apply the useful AIP Evolve constrained-improvement methodology through existing canonical Work and Evidence contracts in an isolated branch.
successCriteria: Ponytail and common baseline source are pinned and other sessions remain untouched.
A source-grounded task-specific rubric fixes meaningful quality and efficiency criteria before candidate outcomes.
The common harness offers a reusable bounded read-only improvement preflight/comparison using existing evaluation semantics.
Meaningful tests, required common/package/source-provider checks and independent source review support the candidate.
The user receives a clear Korean explanation of the fixed rubric and actual execution flow.
inScope: Isolated source analysis and local branch changes
Existing Wiki methodology research and attributed transfer
Pure evaluation comparison, bounded CLI, portable Work inputs and documentation
Ponytail scope/reuse/review treatment and measurement design
outOfScope: Unrequested native model evaluation suite or reuse of historical model budgets
Global plugin/Skill/config changes, native session control or activation
Changes to another active worktree or shared native stores
Automatic merge, production deployment, actual Acceptance inferred from evaluation
